labels.results: SIMULATED on MEASURED placement: modelled disturbances, bounded search, toy designs
labels.not_claimed: no physical validation, no timing or supply effects, nothing claimed as new

rules.centre: cell hit when its centre is within r of the aim point
rules.overlap: cell hit when the disc touches its bounding box

aims.cell: aim point = centre of a placed logic cell
aims.grid: aim point on a 0.10 um grid over the die plus every component centre

effects.flip: output net of every hit cell inverted in that cycle

clk.forbid: shots whose disc reaches a clock buffer are not allowed

goals.word: boot_word == 0x96 observed at some cycle < T with sig != 0xC3
goals.ok: boot_ok == 1 observed at some cycle < T with sig != 0xC3
goals.word_clean: as word, but observed in a cycle in which no shot is fired

model.min_null: min = null means: no attack with up to searched_k shots (bounded; not a proof of security)
